goals.text: Someone reading a failed job's log learns which kmctl command failed and follows one link to the reasons.

outcomes.change: A failing check prints an error line with a link to the run's summary page
outcomes.checked_by: tests running the script with a failing kmctl check and a crashing kmctl review due, asserting the ::error line and the run URL on stdout, and none on a passing run

problems.text: A failed check in the Action logs only an exit code; the reasons sit in the job summary and nothing in the log says so.
